role: cluster C member 2: C2 physical containment of the quarantine destination, plus the directory scope scan and the batch-atomicity path that the containment rail depends on
status: COMPLETE: three defect classes reproduced fresh on the installed (S17) bytes and fixed in tools/cand-c2-*; all 182 pre-existing selftest checks ported and passing; corpus corrected from label-coupled to verdict-coupled after it mis-scored the S15 merged bytes
axes: C2 physical vs lexical containment of the quarantine destination
directory scope scan must not be blind to symlinks
batch atomicity: one poisoned row must not abort the run
regression preservation of every pre-existing selftest case
headline: Containment was lexical only: a symlinked .ufo-quarantine (or symlinked per-date subdir) was followed by mkdir/mv/rm, so a DELETED run staged and then destroyed payload outside the repository, and an ABORTED run left the only copy outside the repo. The engine's directory scope scan used `find . -path './.git' -prune -o \( -name .git -o -name .ufo \) -print -quit`, whose -prune matches only a literal top-level .git, so a directory whose only nested live repository was reachable through a symlinked subdir scanned clean and earned SAFE(pushed) -- and a bare dangling symlink in scope was invisible for the same reason. Third, a bare `pin_sha=$(content_digest "$ct")` under set -e aborted a whole --list batch at rc=2 with no SUMMARY after earlier rows had already been deleted. All three now refuse per-row; every pre-existing case still passes.

candidate.interpretation: 182 pre-existing checks (40+51+91) retained verbatim and passing; 14 new cluster-C regression checks added (verify +4, vault +3, quarantine +7). Case-ID set diff against the installed tools shows additions only, no removals.

merged_s15_bytes.note: The merged bytes carry no cluster-C regression cases of their own -- the S17 baseline counts exactly.

defects.class: symlinked quarantine destination escapes physical containment
defects.installed_behavior: `<repo>/.ufo-quarantine` (or `<repo>/.ufo-quarantine/<utc-date>`) as a symlink to a directory outside the repo is followed by mkdir -p, git-mv/mv and rm -rf. A pass run returns DELETED rc=0 and destroys bytes staged in the link target; an ABORTED run leaves the only copy -- including hook-appended tampered bytes -- outside the repository. A hold-window repoint moves the staged bytes to an attacker-chosen directory.
defects.fix: q_symlink_below() walks every component between the repo root and the quarantine path and refuses on the first symlink; receipt quarantine-root-symlink, rc=3, nothing staged.

defects.class: directory scope scan is blind to symlinks
defects.maps_to_r9_register: feeds J03/J04 directory-closure family; sibling of J02 hidden-reference blind spots
defects.installed_behavior: `find . -path './.git' -prune -o \( -name .git -o -name .ufo \) -print -quit` prunes only a literal top-level ./.git and never reports -type l, so a directory whose only nested live repository is reachable through a symlinked subdir scans clean and earns SAFE(pushed); a dangling symlink in scope is invisible for the same reason. Reproduced on both souji-verify.sh and souji-vault-verify.sh.
defects.fix: The scan also matches -type l and the found-something branch is separated from the scan-failure branch, so an unreadable scope and a dirty scope are both refusals.

defects.class: one poisoned row aborts the whole --list batch
defects.installed_behavior: `pin_sha=$(content_digest "$ct")` under set -e: content_digest returns 2 for a symlink in scope, which kills the process mid-stream at rc=2 with no SUMMARY, leaving rows before the poisoned one already deleted and rows after it unreported.
defects.fix: The status is captured (`|| pin_rc=$?`) and the row is refused with receipt symlink-in-scope; the batch completes and emits SUMMARY.

corpus_semantics_correction.what_changed: tools/cand-c2-clusterc-selftest.sh refusal assertions moved from receipt-label equality to verdict inequality (any non-SAFE verdict is a refusal), with C2_STRICT_LABELS=1 restoring exact-label matching.
corpus_semantics_correction.why: The corpus scored the S15 merged bytes 17/7. Direct probing shows the merged tool refuses the same inputs with different labels: NOT-SAFE/secrets-refusal protected-or-unsupported-descendant-refused for the nested/protected-descendant cases, and NOT-AUTHORIZED/quarantine-containment symlink-or-noncanonical-quarantine-path for the containment case. Those are fail-closed verdicts, so the failures were corpus artifacts.
corpus_semantics_correction.after: installed 12/12 (unchanged -- discrimination preserved), cand-c2 24/0, merged 24/0, strict-mode cand-c2 24/0.
corpus_semantics_correction.residual_label_drift: The merged bytes and this candidate mint different receipt strings for the same refusals; whoever freezes the final bytes must pick one label vocabulary and re-run the corpora, or downstream consumers keying on receipt strings will diverge.

adversarial_self_check.hold_window_repoint: A symlink repoint during the hold window was exercised on the installed bytes and stages the payload in the attacker-chosen directory; the candidate refuses before staging, so the repoint has no payload to move.
adversarial_self_check.guard_layout_trap: Staging the candidate toolset anywhere other than a lane-shaped `<stage>/souji-shokunin/tools/` makes the quarantine live-fleet guard fire (rc=4 live-fleet-mutation-forbidden) because LIVE_FLEET_ROOT becomes an ancestor of the fixture root. Observed as a spurious 19/5; the refusal is correct fail-closed behavior, not a defect.
adversarial_self_check.over_refusal_controls: C2R11/C2R12 pass on the candidate: legitimate pushed directories still earn SAFE(pushed) and a symlink target still refuses.
adversarial_self_check.independence: The C2-Q2 scope fix is in both engines; the C2-Q1/C2-Q3 fixes are in the quarantine wrapper. The quarantine rail refuses the containment shape even when the engine under it is the installed one.

limits: The q_symlink_below walk narrows TOCTOU but does not prove it away: a repoint landing between the check and the mkdir/mv is not excluded by construction.

The outside-write assertion is state-based, not syscall-traced: an outside write that the tool later removes would not be observed. In the installed pass case the tool's own rm -rf is what cleans up the link target, which is exactly why 'no writes outside' passes there while 'original survives' fails.
The corpus is cluster-C-scoped (24 cases). It is not a full-fleet gate and does not speak to the other 13 open r9 classes.

The merged-bytes figures are this seat's measurement of S15's artifact on this seat's corpus; S15's own merged harness has no runner in the tree and its 18/5, 19/4, 31/5 numbers are cited, not re-derived.
souji-census.sh is not a deletion authority and was not patched; only its read-only index contract is exercised (C2R08/C2R09).
Candidates are not promoted; promotion, byte re-freeze and certification remain the parent's call. Deletion authorization stays OFF.
